assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and to guide further management of the unspecified cardiac rhythm disturbance.
The CPT code for the procedure is 93229.
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I25.10, and I34.0.
The documented indications support the medical necessity of the diagnostic procedure.
